Gatling API Tool: Detailed Scenario Runbook

Scenario: orders-service / qa
Flow: GET /orders -> GET /orders/#{orderId} -> POST /orders
Targets: Success >= 99%, p95 <= 1200ms, p99 <= 2000ms

1. Installation and Startup

  • Run check-prerequisites.bat
  • Run start-ui-workspace.bat
  • Verify UI Runner API is http://127.0.0.1:8787
cd gatling-api-tool
check-prerequisites.bat
start-ui-workspace.bat

2. App and Base Service Setup

  • Application: orders-service
  • Base URL: https://qa.api.company.com
  • Auth: bearer via env API_TOKEN
  • Assertions: minSuccess 99, maxRT 2000, p95 1200

3. Injection Profiles

  • smoke_5: 5 users / 15 sec
  • baseline_20: ramp 20 users / 60 sec
  • stress_80: ramp 80 users / 180 sec
  • Map scenario to baseline_20 for QA baseline run

4. Scenario Steps (Core)

  • Step 1: GET /orders expected 200
  • Step 2: GET /orders/#{orderId} expected 200
  • Step 3: POST /orders expected 201

5. Checks and Captures

  • Add checks: jsonPathExists($.items[0].id), bodyContains("order")
  • Capture: $.items[0].id -> orderId
  • Use capture in next step path: /orders/#{orderId}

6. Environments, Headers, Certs

  • Define environment qa with specific URL/auth overrides
  • Use global headers in Advanced mode
  • Configure TLS cert/trust store only when required

7. Expert / Raw YAML

  • Click Sync Generated YAML Into Editor
  • Enable Use Raw YAML: On only for edge-case overrides
  • Keep diff minimal and preserve profile/assertion structure

7A. Conditional Statements (If/Else) Example

  • Drive branching using captured/session values like #{customerTier}
  • If premium: call premium route; else call standard route
  • Use explicit expected status on both branch and else path
steps:
  - name: "Route By Tier"
    method: "GET"
    path: "/orders"
    branches:
      - name: "Premium Path"
        when:
          variable: "customerTier"
          operator: "equals"
          value: "premium"
        method: "GET"
        path: "/orders/premium"
        expectedStatus: 200
    elseMethod: "GET"
    elsePath: "/orders/standard"
    elseExpectedStatus: 200

8. Real Run and Diagnostics

  • Run Check Runner, then Run Real Load (Gatling)
  • Track run state, job id, and output tail
  • Confirm report availability is Final

9. Report Analysis

  • Primary KPIs: success %, p95, p99, max RT
  • Use failure reason table first for triage
  • Use parity diagnostics to distinguish preview limitations

10. Save Suite and Release

  • Save suite as orders-qa-regression
  • Create release package via build-release.bat
  • Share zip + latest-bundle.sha256
